## Hello

I'm Jeison, a statistician from Cali, Colombia. I studied statistics at Universidad del Valle, and my thesis compared methods for estimating the fractional differencing parameter in long-memory time series with conditional heteroscedasticity. That started a long interest in time series that I still have: ARIMA and GARCH models, state-space models, Kalman filters and Gaussian processes.

After my degree I joined CIAT, the International Center for Tropical Agriculture, where I spent several years on climate and agriculture. I automated the path from climate data to crop simulation in R and modelled how climate change could affect crops across Latin America. Some of that work was recognised with a UNFCCC Momentum for Change award in 2017 and shared at the AGU Fall Meeting in 2016, and I co-authored papers in journals such as *Climate Services*, *Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution* and *Computers and Electronics in Agriculture*.

Since 2021 I've worked at Globant on machine learning and AI projects: customer segmentation and churn, forecasting, recommendation, text embeddings and semantic search. I currently work as an AI engineer. I also taught probability, inference and time series at university level.

## What I like working on

- Forecasting and filtering: state-space models, Kalman filters, structural time series
- Spatial and climate data
- Taking a model from a notebook to something other people can rely on

## Tools

R (advanced), Python, SQL, PySpark, Docker, Git, AWS and GCP. The full list is on the [CV](cv.qmd).
